verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a free open-source package for local fine-tuning and paid platform tiers (Starter, Pro, Custom) for hosted GPUs and extra features. Nothing in the pack states the software license or whether commercial or enterprise use of the free edition requires a paid license. Pricing for hosted features is adjacent information, not a documented commercial-use licensing policy.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
